title: Detects calls to standard library iterator algorithms that could be replaced with a Boost ranges version instead.

title: This check finds conversion from integer type like int to std::string or std::wstring using boost::lexical_cast, and replace it with calls to std::to_string and std::to_wstring.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the boost module of clang-tidy.
